author: copper354
body:
Hello, Hello!

           My name is Harrison, or Harry, but most people know me as Harreh, as my username is HarrehIsHere
    I've actually been playing avicus, for wow, quite some time maybe a year and a half. I enjoy DTM matches, I'm usually rushing, but      
    other times I'm just laying back killing, or getting crafty with defending. I like to stay to rushing normally as I'm not the best PvPer.
    I enjoyed playing on other servers more than I do now, but I think from now on, The Avicus Network is going to be where I'm on the      
    most.

    You might of known me as some of these previous usernames
    copper354
   Harrison_
    or YerBoiHarry      <-- wo thet wus a stuped une o3o

    I guess that pretty much wraps it up, bye!
